title: [SOLVED] Why do I still have Qt5?
body: I run Arch with KDE, fully up-to-date and I thought the last Qt5 application I installed was keepassxc, which is now based on Qt6. See: https://github.com/keepassxreboot/keepa … /tag/2.8.0 and https://archlinux.org/packages/extra/x86_64/keepassxc/ I would have thought Qt5 would now be orphaned, but it is not. When I look at the Required By: it seems as if none of the Qt5 pieces are required by any applications. The three packages that qt5-base is Required By don't seem to support anything else.
